name: What are the benefits of expanding a driveway versus repaving the existing one?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of expanding a driveway versus repaving the existing one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expanding a driveway provides additional usable space for parking, maneuvering vehicles, or creating recreational areas, addressing a need for more room. Repaving, on the other hand, solely focuses on restoring the surface quality and appearance of your current driveway without increasing its footprint. If your primary goal is to accommodate more vehicles or enhance the functionality of your property, expansion is the solution. If the existing driveway is structurally sound but worn, repaving is sufficient. Both can improve curb appeal, but expansion offers greater utility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Driveway expansion adds usable space for parking and maneuvering, while repaving only refreshes the existing surface. Choose expansion for more room, repaving for surface restoration.
